invitation.title: Dear friends and family!
invitation.body:
With great joy, we invite your family to share with us one of the most important and happiest days of our lives — our wedding day!

We would be delighted to have you by our side on this special occasion. We dream of celebrating it surrounded by family and close friends, sharing joy, warm emotions, sincere smiles, and creating memories that will stay with us for many years to come.

This day will be filled with love, happiness, laughter, and a heartfelt atmosphere, and we truly want you to be part of it. Your presence will be the most precious gift for us and will make this celebration even more special.

We look forward to seeing you and sharing this beautiful day together with you!

chat.title: Our wedding chat
chat.body:
We have created a shared chat on Telegram — that is where all the latest news about the celebration will appear. Join in to ask any question or to check the most up-to-date details.

And during the celebration, do share your photos and videos there — that way we will gather all the warmest moments of the day in one place.

items.title: Meeting of the groom and the bride
items.desc: A touching meeting of the couple and the traditional bride ransom. We get to know each other and get into the festive mood. Please note: parking is limited at this location.

items.title: Ceremony
items.desc: A solemn open-air ceremony on a beautiful lavender field. Get your handkerchiefs ready for a touching moment, and afterwards drinks, delicious food, music, a great mood and plenty of lovely spots for photos await us.

items.title: Arrival at the restaurant
items.desc: We mingle in the welcome zone with champagne. A seating plan will be prepared for you — find your table, take your seats and get ready for a delicious meal.

items.title: Party start
items.desc: Fun awaits us, a wonderful host, contests and a great mood, as well as delicious food and unlimited drinks.

items.title: Cake
items.desc: We hope and know that you will still have the energy for the festive cake and dancing that follows

footer.title: A note for guests with children
footer.body:
At the ceremony venue we have fenced off parts of the grounds with green netting. Please make sure children do not go behind it or touch the netting itself.

At the restaurant, during the couple's first dance, cold smoke will flow across the floor. Please keep your little ones close so they do not run into the middle of the dance floor.

Thank you sincerely for your understanding. We love you!
